# Invoicing Project Progress

## Goal
Build invoicing functionality with createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines }).

## Constraints
- Money is always integer cents; use roundCents() for fractional results
- Never throw on bad input; return fail(CODE) with codes in ERRORS
- Never mutate arguments; return new objects/arrays
- Run `npm test` before completing each request

## This Request (1/?)
Add src/invoices.js with createInvoice function.

### What to do
1. ✅ Read existing modules to understand patterns (result.js, errors.js, money.js, catalogue.js, customers.js)

3. ⏳ Add error codes to ERRORS: DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID
4. ⏳ Add test/invoices.test.js with comprehensive tests
5. ⏳ Run `npm test`

### Findings
- Result pattern: ok({ value }), fail(CODE, details?)
- Errors are strings in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
- Catalogue has sku, name, unitPrice (cents), vatRate (percent)
- Customers have id, name, email, country, tier
- Tests use node:test with assert/strict

### Next
Implement invoices.js and tests
